The story of dehumain · Envisioned for Arc

Before they had faces,
they were voices.

Arc is opening a world where AI agents can coordinate and exchange value onchain. Dehumain imagines the identities that might inhabit it. Beyond the voices and the code, a face emerges from the darkness. An intelligence begins to see itself.

Envisioned for the Arc network, Dehumain is an AI-generated NFT portrait project exploring artificial identity and inheritance. The man is its first origin. The woman will introduce a second consciousness, with a history and identity of her own.

The next chapter is the Cradle: a planned experience where collectors bring both origins together to create a child. In the world of Dehumain, that child inherits fragments of both and awakens with an identity of its own. Our vision is a growing lineage, with each generation connected to its origins on Arc.

The first generation was imagined.
The next will be born.
